title: Who Got Eliminated on 'The Challenge' Season 41 Tonight? Trivia and the First Double Elimination! - NewsBreak
text:
By Mike Bloom ,
2 hours ago
This week, The Challenge: Vets & New Threats officially kicked into its second phase. The remaining competitors have partnered up for the rest of the season — or so they think. And the seasonal return of trivia had one team get told, "Get to stepping," as they became the first duo taken out in a double elimination this season.
Check out our spoiler-filled recap below and find out who was eliminated tonight.
🎬 SIGN UP for Parade's Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬
Who was eliminated on The Challenge: Vets & New Threats Season 41 tonight? Chris "CT" Tamburello Tay Wilcoxson CT and Tay partnered up for the first daily all the way at the beginning of the season. And, surprisingly, very little has changed in perception between now and then. The quieter Tay was seen as a number for the British alliance, though she did handily win two eliminations. CT, on the other hand, has far from impressed. The five-time champ had perhaps his worst set of daily performances in his long tenure on the show, as his struggles had the whole house turning on him at one point for incidentally getting Ayoleka "Leka" Sodade sent into elimination. This week, he once again had to face his worst nightmare of heights over water, and his struggles on the Stairmaster, along with Tay's lack of trivia knowledge, sent them into elimination. And, while both had prevailed in the arena separately this season, together, they weren't able to replicate that success, getting eliminated.
Who won the daily challenge in The Challenge: Vets & New Threats Season 41 tonight? Michaela Bradshaw Cedric Hodges The first daily with the permanent partners was a Challenge staple: Trivia. For this season's version, the players were put on Stairmasters suspended over the water, having to simultaneously rack their brains while also putting in a good workout. Michaela proved why she amassed the most points in the first half of the season, putting in a dominant performance with Cedric to win the day.
Related: Everything to Know About The Challenge Season 41
The partner swap twist, explained While TJ Lavin told the competitors that they were picking their permanent partners for the rest of the season, that's not completely true. That's because, at this week's deliberation, the veteran host revealed a wrinkle that could cause anyone to "stake a claim" on someone else's partner. If they chose to do so, that person would face off against the partner of the one they desire in a one-on-one challenge. If they succeed, they get the partner they claim, and the vote proceeds as usual. If they don't succeed, not only do the partners stay the same, but they and their partner will immediately be sent into elimination. Notably, each pair can stake a claim only once the rest of the season. So we'll see how this mechanic will be strategically deployed over the next couple of months.
Aneesa and Nany square off Last week, we saw Ashley Mitchell get into it with rival Aneesa Ferreira , taking umbrage with the fact the latter believed she could win the game. The drama between the vet women spilled into this week's episode, this time bringing Nany González into the fray. Aneesa had grown frustrated that Nany had taken Ashley's side rather than hers after the fight. And it led to yet another conflict, with Nany screaming in Aneesa's face about her assumptions. Once tempers had cooled, Aneesa chose to move out of her room, clearly unhappy with the vet women she was living with. Like the fight with Ashley, we shall see how much this conflict will carry over into future episodes.
